drhp.business: Valiant Communications, founded in 1994 and headquartered in New Delhi, designs telecom transmission, synchronization, grid protection and cybersecurity equipment for mission-critical networks. Its products include IP/MPLS and MPLS-TP routers, SDH/PDH multiplexers, ruggedized industrial switches, teleprotection systems, GPS/GNSS/NavIC time-synchronization clocks, phasor measurement units and phasor data concentrators, grid islanding systems, data diodes, network isolation equipment, OT honeypots and quantum-safe, EMP-protected NAS/SAN storage. Power and utilities form its largest end market, and it also serves oil and gas pipelines, railways and metros, airports, defence, BFSI and government. Its equipment is installed in more than 6,000 substations and in over 100 countries. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract manufacturers, with the company supplying design, processes and materials. It supplies utility projects together with Tejas Networks, which acts as lead bidder, including communication, protection and synchronization equipment for GETCO.
